title: Carrier minus support is H^n-null (Simon 4.10(1); positivity of theta)
statement: Let U be any subset of R^(n+l) and V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U (contract structure: M ⊆ U, M H^n-null-measurable, theta > 0 on M, theta a.e.-measurable for H^n restricted to M). Its weight is mu = V.weight = (H^n restricted to M) with density ofReal(theta), and spt V = U ∩ spt mu. Then H^n(M \ spt V) = 0, where H^n = muHE[n]. No density hypothesis and no openness of U is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (V.carrier \ V.support) = 0
